text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience, and I’d love to support Flying Start Marketing with your customer persona and target market presentations.

In my work on Warehouse models for a DTC brand (p06), I built a dbt project with staging, intermediate, and mart layers for orders, subscriptions, and marketing, which supported a dashboard refresh from daily to hourly. In Marketing attribution analysis (p02), I joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click, last-click, and position-based credit, which helped reallocate 18% of the ad budget.

I’m comfortable following step-by-step guides, working with Google Drive, and organizing data clearly for client-facing deliverables. With extensive experience in SQL, Excel, Google Sheets, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization, I can help turn research into polished, easy-to-understand slides.
